records.explanation: Ethane has relative formula mass (2 x 12) + (6 x 1) = 30. For 0.5 moles, the mass is 0.5 x 30 = 15 g.
Magnesium chloride has relative formula mass 24 + (2 x 35.5) = 95. For 0.5 moles, the mass is 0.5 x 95 = 47.5 g.
The moles of HCl are 0.100 x 0.0225 = 0.00225 mol. The reaction ratio is 1:1, so the NaOH concentration is 0.00225 / 0.0250 = 0.090 mol dm-3.
Total input is 1200 + 800 = 2000 MW. Efficiency is 1200 / 2000 x 100 = 60%.
Power is P = V x I = 230 x 0.435 = 100.05 W, which rounds to 100 W.
Energy used is 50 W x 8 h = 400 Wh = 0.4 kWh. At 15p per kWh, the cost is 0.4 x 15p = 6p.
